User Stories: As a user, I want to browse products, apply filters, and sort the results on the Product List Page so that I can easily find and select items to view in detail.
Scenario:
Scenario: Verify dynamic updates upon applying multiple filters
Given the user is on the Product List Page
When the user selects a specific "Size" filter
And the user selects a specific "Color" filter
Then the product list should dynamically update to display only products matching both selected filters
And the total result count should accurately reflect the number of filtered products

User Stories: As a user, I want to browse products, apply filters, and sort the results on the Product List Page so that I can easily find and select items to view in detail.
Scenario:
Scenario: Verify sorting accuracy and navigation to Product Detail Page
Given the user is on the Product List Page with multiple products displayed
When the user selects "Price: Low to High" from the sorting dropdown
Then the displayed product cards should be ordered from the lowest price to the highest price
When the user clicks on the first product card in the sorted list
Then the user should be navigated to the corresponding Product Detail Page of the selected product
